title: Edit one active Space checklist collection

surfaces.currentBehavior: Owns one isolated active-Space checklist editor draft, every catalogued structure/text/check/reorder action, stable identity and presentation-order preservation, exact validation, pre-acceptance Cancel, complete-replacement Save, uncertain-acceptance replay, accepted optimism adoption, exact read-only rejected-command recovery, and lifecycle drainage. Rejected-operation retry, dismissal and resolution are absent.
surfaces.notes: The editor contains no backend-specific logic and delegates one typed draft to the shared verified revision coordinator. O-051 blocks rejected-operation retry linkage, acknowledgment and resolution, but not exact read-only recovery.
